```{r setup, include=FALSE, purl=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(root.dir = here::here())

.name_script <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) {
  knitr::current_input()
} else {
  rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()[["path"]]
}
.name_script <- fs::path_ext_remove(basename(.name_script))

library <- function(...) suppressPackageStartupMessages(base::library(...))
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
source("1_code/_Initialize.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
source("1_code/_Utils.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
source("1_code/_NER.R", encoding = "UTF-8")

cat("Main Directory: ")
(.dir_main <- init_create_script_dir(here::here(), .name_script))

cat("Function File: ")
(.path_fun <- init_create_script_fun(here::here(), .name_script))
```


## Path Tree

```{r}
.lP <- list(
  Input = list(
    SampleContracts = "0_sample/"
  ),
  Cache = list(
    NerExtraction = utils_file_path(.dir_main, "Cache", "NerExtraction")
  ),
  Output = list()
)
```


# Test NER
```{r}
fil_sample_dirs <- utils_list_files(.lP$Input$SampleContracts)
```


```{r}
ner_run(
  .inputs    = fil_sample_dirs$Path[25],
  .output    = file.path(.lP$Cache$NerExtraction, paste0("NER_", basename(fil_sample_dirs$Path[25]), ".parquet")),
  .engines   = c("spacy", "lexnlp"),
  .labels    = c("ORG", "GPE", "DATE", "MONEY"),
  .model     = c("en_core_web_sm", "en_core_web_md", "en_core_web_lg", "en_core_web_trf"),
  .n_process = 10L
)
```

```{r}
tab <- arrow::read_parquet("2_output/03-NamedEntities/Cache/NerExtraction/spacy_en_core_web_trf_NER_2005-2.parquet") |> 
  dplyr::left_join(utils_list_files(fil_sample_dirs$Path[25]), by = dplyr::join_by(DocID))
```


```{r}
i = 4
arrow::read_parquet(tab$Path[i], "TextRaw")[["TextRaw"]] |> 
  substr(tab$Start[i] + 1, tab$Stop[i])

tab$Span[i]
tab$Label[i]
```
